meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

copy.tagline: 接入端到端加密的邮件消息通道到你的应用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你要在应用中接入端到端加密邮件消息。
copy.tagline_en: Add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add an email-based encrypted messaging channel to your app.

howto.what: 装上后，用户要求添加 DeltaChat 渠道时，Claude 会执行集成步骤：复制渠道适配器文件、安装 @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server 依赖、配置邮箱凭据，使消息通过加密电子邮件收发。
howto.when: 当用户要求添加或集成 DeltaChat 渠道，或需要配置 DeltaChat 邮箱账户时触发。

say.text: 帮我添加 DeltaChat 渠道
say.note: Claude 会开始执行集成流程。

say.text: 配置 DeltaChat 的邮箱凭据
say.note: Claude 会指导设置 IMAP/SMTP 信息。

say.text: 把 DeltaChat 消息接到代理群组

howto.what_en: When the user asks to add DeltaChat, Claude runs the integration steps: copies adapter files, installs @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server, configures email credentials, enabling encrypted email messaging.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to add or integrate DeltaChat, or to configure its email account.

say_en.text: Help me add the DeltaChat channel

say_en.note: Claude will guide setting up IMAP/SMTP.

say_en.text: Wire DeltaChat messages to an agent group
